class.name: MidiNote
class.description: [method MidiDriver.note_on] returns one. MIDI itself knows a note only by its channel and key, so two notes on the same key and channel cannot be told apart; a [MidiNote] refers to exactly one of them. Dropping the reference does not end the note. A note with no length sounds until [method off] (or [method MidiDriver.note_off], or the transport stopping) ends it. [codeblock] var n := midi.note_on(1, 60, 100) await get_tree().create_timer(0.5).timeout n.off() [/codeblock]

method.name: get_id
method.description: The note's id, unique within its driver. Targets receive it as [code]note_id[/code] with each of the note's events.

method.name: get_key
method.description: The note's key, 0 to 127 (60 is middle C).

method.name: is_active
method.description: [code]true[/code] until the note has ended: while it waits for its time, and while it sounds.

method.name: is_sounding
method.description: [code]true[/code] from the moment the note starts until it ends.

method.name: off
method.description: Ends this note, now or at [param at] (see [method MidiDriver.note_on] for [param at]). A note that has not started yet never starts.
